name: Podium
oneLiner: AI-powered customer communication platform for local businesses, built around texting, reviews, payments and an AI Employee that answers leads and books appointments; now sold mainly as vertical 'AI operating systems'.
bestFor: Local service businesses such as auto dealers and repair shops, home services, medspas and retail that sell through calls and texts; less of a fit for restaurants, which are not one of Podium's focus industries.

updates.text: Launched Jerry 2.0, a customizable AI employee built on OpenAI models for automotive, HVAC and medspa businesses.

Launched an AI operating system for aesthetic practices combining EMR, patient messaging, marketing and an AI agent for lead response and booking; a home services version was announced in August 2026.
Said its AI agent business passed $150 million in annual recurring revenue about two and a half years after launch (company-reported).

features: AI Employee that replies to leads by text, phone, email and social, answers questions and books appointments after hours
Voice AI agent that answers phone calls
Review invitations by text that send customers to Google and other review sites
Shared inbox for texts, webchat, Google and social messages
Text-to-pay links and payments inside a conversation
Bulk text campaigns for promotions and re-engagement
Review and conversation reporting across locations
Industry-specific AI operating systems for automotive, home services and aesthetics

pricing.text: Not published; plans (Core, Pro, Signature) are quoted by sales. AI Employee is sold as an add-on to any base plan.
